title: Lexicographically least models from SAT decision on restriction-closed CNFs
claims: RestrictionClosedLeastSATModel proves a polynomial-time extractor of a lexicographically least model on any restriction-closed CNF fragment that has a polynomial-time SAT decision procedure.
RenamableHornLeastSATModel specializes the theorem to renamable Horn without a supplied renaming or decision oracle.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.
